GetTemplateResult.TemplateBody: AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09' Description: 'Storefront web tier: ALB, ECS service, image resizer' Parameters: ImageTag: {Type: String} DesiredCount: {Type: Number, Default: 3} VpcStack: {Type: String, Default: acme-network} Resources: PublicLoadBalancer: Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer Properties: Name: storefront-alb Scheme: internet-facing Subnets: !Split [',', !ImportValue {'Fn::Sub': '${VpcStack}-PublicSubnets'}] WebTargetGroup: Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup Properties: Name: storefront-web Port: 8080 Protocol: HTTP TargetType: ip HealthCheckPath: /healthz HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30 VpcId: !ImportValue {'Fn::Sub': '${VpcStack}-VpcId'} WebService: Type: AWS::ECS::Service Properties: ServiceName: storefront-web Cluster: acme-prod DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount LaunchType: FARGATE TaskDefinition: !Ref WebTaskDefinition LoadBalancers: - {ContainerName: web, ContainerPort: 8080, TargetGroupArn: !Ref WebTargetGroup} WebTaskDefinition: Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition Properties: Family: storefront-web TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt WebTaskRole.Arn ContainerDefinitions: - Name: web Image: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/storefront-web:${ImageTag}' WebTaskRole: Type: AWS::IAM::Role Properties: RoleName: storefront-web-task ThumbnailFunction: Type: AWS::Lambda::Function Properties: FunctionName: thumbnail-resizer Runtime: python3.12 Outputs: LoadBalancerDns: Value: !GetAtt PublicLoadBalancer.DNSName
